verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only context within a single thread or conversation (Agent API 'conversation context across turns', 'Thread Follow-Ups'). It also shows a Library of past searches and reusable API configuration profiles. None of these documents the assistant remembering context from previous chats and applying it in new conversations. These are adjacent features, not cross-chat memory.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations
